title: Mac Flecknoe

vibeProfile.oneLine: Dryden crowns a rival poet king of dullness, in a gleeful mock-epic.

summary: Dryden's brilliant mock-epic crowns a rival poet, Thomas Shadwell, as heir to a kingdom of dullness, mocking him in the grand, solemn language of true epic to devastating comic effect. The founding poem of English literary satire, it turned a personal quarrel into an art form and set the template for later mock-heroic verse. This scholarly edition supplies the context and notes. Short, sharp and gleefully cruel, it is one of the funniest attacks in English poetry.
whyReadIt: The founding poem of English satire, a gleefully cruel mock-epic. Short, sharp and very funny.

funFacts.text: It set the template for the mock-heroic satire that Pope would later perfect.
